_**Agent (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 2026-05-12 09:25:10Z)**_

Your local `main` branch is behind the remote. Two options:

**Safest (merge the remote changes):**
```bash
git pull origin main
git push origin main
```

**Cleaner history (rebase instead):**
```bash
git pull --rebase origin main
git push origin main
```

Use the first if you want to preserve a merge commit showing when you synced. Use the second if you want your local commits to appear on top of the remote's latest without a merge commit.
